consumer: The mission/objective completion check that lights the 'objective met' indicator, asking 'are the required fetch parts accounted for in the objective's required scope?'
scope: The fetch objective's own required-item reach (the engine's objective/mission item count over reachable/eligible inventory, including carried/worn/containers), not just ground stacks on visible tiles in the export window
decisive_source: src/arcopolis_export.cpp::write_entities(items) iterates points_in_radius+in_export_window and reads only get_map().i_at(p) ground stacks; it never invokes the mission/objective completion predicate, so it is raw windowed map state of the wrong scope
divergence: The player has already picked up the required parts so they sit in the player's carried inventory (or just outside the export radius): the engine fetch objective predicate reads 'met', but the per-tile ground scan finds zero matching items in the window and leaves the indicator dark
